messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Pella Greenwick pushes three wrapped parcels across the Morning Star counter.

One hums, one drips, and one smells faintly like cinnamon.

(Pella Greenwick) "Easy first route. Probably. Take the humming one last unless it starts singing."
